title: NLP-P3 Event Integration — NLP与P3事件引擎集成
description: Connect all NLP outputs to the P3 event engine via BaseDetector implementations. Create 6 NLP detectors (AnnouncementDetector, ResearchReportDetector, NewsSentimentDetector, PolicyDetector, NERDetector, EventExtractionDetector) that implement BaseDetector ABC, register with DetectorRegistry, and map NLP confidence scores to Event.confidence_score. This is the final Wave 4 integration task that depends on all previous NLP tasks.

criteria: 6 NLP detectors implemented: [AnnouncementDetector, ResearchReportDetector, NewsSentimentDetector, PolicyDetector, NERDetector, EventExtractionDetector]
NLP events flow through PropagationGraph correctly
Graceful degradation: NLP failure returns None, no crash
20+ unit tests + 5+ integration tests pass: verify by py -m pytest tests/unit/test_nlp_detectors.py tests/integration/test_nlp_event_pipeline.py -p no:asyncio -q (exit code 0)
All existing P3 tests continue to pass

implementation.title: Implement 6 NLP BaseDetector classes
implementation.description: Create synapse/event/nlp_detectors.py with 6 detectors implementing BaseDetector ABC: AnnouncementDetector (F-037→EARNINGS_FORECAST), ResearchReportDetector (F-038→SOCIAL_SENTIMENT), NewsSentimentDetector (F-039→SOCIAL_SENTIMENT), PolicyDetector_NLP (F-040→POLICY_CHANGE), NERDetector (F-041→metadata enrichment), EventExtractionDetector (F-042→varies). Each detector: detect(data) calls corresponding NLP module, maps output to Event schema.
logic_flow: Implement AnnouncementDetector: detect() calls AnnouncementParser, maps to EARNINGS_FORECAST Event
Implement ResearchReportDetector: detect() calls ReportSummarizer, maps to SOCIAL_SENTIMENT Event
Implement NewsSentimentDetector: detect() calls NewsSentimentClassifier, maps to SOCIAL_SENTIMENT Event
Implement PolicyDetector_NLP: detect() calls PolicyUnderstander, maps to POLICY_CHANGE Event
Implement NERDetector: detect() calls NEREngine, enriches Event metadata with entities
Implement EventExtractionDetector: detect() calls EventExtractor, maps to P3 EventType
